structuralFinding.consequence: checkStateSupported can only ever refuse a NON-ACTIVE state. Every candidate it deletes was already non-ACTIVE, so deletion and demotion are BOTH non-asserting. The delete-vs-demote choice therefore cannot move hazard detection, false ACTIVE, or the high-consequence gate.
